title: Quantity Carried by a Continuity-of-Care Quantity Limit Authorization — Acute Migraine Drugs
content:
**Determination (Utilization Management Program).** A continuity-of-care quantity limit authorization for an acute migraine drug — sumatriptan, whose limit is 9 units, Nurtec ODT, whose limit is 8 units, or Ubrelvy, whose limit is 16 units per rolling 30 days — carries the quantity per rolling 30 days that the prior carrier's approval on file states, being the quantity asked for on the member's case relying on that approval, but never more than the continuity ceiling, which is the drug's limit times three quarters (0.75) of the package's maximum exception multiple.

- **The drug** is the drug of the member's most recent case opening that relies on the prior carrier's approval, and **the case** is the member's latest such opening for that drug.
- **The quantity carried** is taken to three decimal places; the continuity ceiling is taken to three decimal places as well; the authorization carries the smaller of the two.
- **The package's maximum exception multiple** is the figure the member's review package states for quantity limit exceptions.

## Continuity ceilings

| Drug (limit) | Package multiple 2.0 | Package multiple 1.5 |
|---|---|---|
| sumatriptan (9) | 13.5 | 10.125 |
| Nurtec ODT (8) | 12 | 9 |
| Ubrelvy (16) | 24 | 18 |

Each figure is the limit times three quarters of the package multiple.

## Worked determinations (hypothetical prior-carrier approvals)

| Drug and package multiple | Quantity on the case relying on the prior carrier's approval | Continuity ceiling | Quantity carried |
|---|---|---|---|
| sumatriptan, 2.0 | 12 | 13.5 | 12 |
| Ubrelvy, 1.5 | 24 | 18 | 18 |
| Nurtec ODT, 2.0 | 10.5 | 12 | 10.5 |

### Basis Q&A

**Whose statement of the quantity counts?** The quantity on the member's case relying on the prior carrier's approval — the quantity that approval states — not a figure the caller quotes from memory.

**What if the prior carrier approved more than the ceiling?** The authorization carries the ceiling.
